The PageProcessor patch expanded reference scanning to types as well as resources, allowed self-references, and added manual CodeSystem references from ValueSet, ConceptMap, and Coding.
additional_context: CodeSystem is active in the current build via source/fhir.ini. Current CodeSystem source describes the relevant ValueSet, Coding.system, TerminologyCapabilities, ConceptMap, and CodeSystem supplement relationships, and build.fhir.org/codesystem.html#4.8.4 lists itself, Coding, ConceptMap, TerminologyCapabilities, ValueSet, and the ValueSet Supplement extension.
